content:
I have made a verso document on monoidal and bicategory, which are tactics based on the coherence theorem, and are available in Mathlib. See: https://yuma-mizuno.github.io/coherence-tactics/

The tactics themselves were written quite some time ago, but I wrote this document now after being inspired by the recent thread #mathlib4 > Difference between `monoidal` and `coherence` tactics, where @Gaëtan Serré has recently been considering using monoidal in measure theory and probability theory context. (I also wanted to have some personal experience writing in verso.)

That is very nice! I will read it for sure (I would like to create such a tactic for copy-discard category). Since you mentioned my thread, I just wanted to let you know that I was able to leverage monoidal for equalities of S-finite Markov kernels. I also made a verso document about this. I will make sure to add a link to yours for more details on monoidal.
Might I suggest that you both add entires to documentation.yaml on the community website?
Well Gaëtan first needs to PR his tactics to Mathlib :)
